mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_mdm_product_info (`FACTORY_CODE`, `PRODUCT_CODE`, `PRODUCT_DESC`, `PRO_SIZE`, `PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE`, `PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME`, `SPECIFICATIONS`, `PATTERN`, `BRAND`, `TIRE_TYPE`, `COMMON_TYPE`, `HIERARCHY`, `REPLACE_GROUP`, `CANT_PRODUCE`, `NO_DELIVERY`, `SPEED`, `CREATE_BY`, `IS_DELETE`, `CREATE_TIME`, `UPDATE_TIME`) SELECT '116', sap_code, SUBSTRING(Mater_Name, LOCATE(' ', Mater_Name) + 1), SUBSTRING(Mater_Name, LOCATE('R', Mater_Name) + 1, 2), 'PCR', '半钢', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(Mater_Name, LOCATE(' ', Mater_Name) + 1), ' ', 1), SUBSTRING_INDEX(Mater_Name, ' ', - (LENGTH(Mater_Name) - LENGTH(REPLACE(Mater_Name, ' ', ''))) + 2), b.DICT_VALUE, null, null, null, null, '0', '0', right(SUBSTRING_INDEX(Mater_Name, ' ', 3), 1), 'MES', 0, now(), now() from t_mes_material t left join sys_dict_data b on b.DICT_TYPE = 'biz_brand_type' and b.locale = 'zh_CN' and b.DICT_LABEL = SUBSTRING_INDEX(Mater_Name,' ',1) where mater_type = '安徽半钢子午线轮胎' and not exists (select 0 from t_mdm_product_info t1 where t1.is_delete = '0' and t.sap_code = t1.PRODUCT_CODE)
